text: So Missy, what brings you all the way from Texas?

text: Was it perhaps destiny, I think it was destiny.

text: My friend's getting married in Disneyland tomorrow night.

text: Destiny, thy name is Anaheim.

text: And I had to drop off some papers for Shelly to sign for my dad's estate.

text: They call me a genius because I' m a genius. Tell Mom that I currently weigh 165 pounds, and that I' m having regular bowel movements. Enjoy the wedding, goodbye.

text: Woah, woah.

text: Woah, woah. If the wedding's not until tomorrow, why don't you stay with us tonight?

text: Oh, I don't think so. Shelly doesn't like company. Even as a little boy he'd send his imaginary friends home at the end of the day.

text: So what? I don't issue invitations to your mother.
